#### Clase `ThreadWriter` (Línea 13)
- **Docstring:** _Assign an instance to sys.stdout for per-thread printing objects - Courtesy Guido!_
- **Métodos:**
  - `def __init__(self)` (Línea 16): Constructor -- initialize the table of writers
  - `def register(self, writer)` (Línea 21): Register the writer for the current thread
  - `def unregister(self)` (Línea 28): Remove the writer for the current thread, if any
  - `def getwriter(self)` (Línea 38): Return the current thread's writer, default sys.stdout
  - `def write(self, str)` (Línea 42): Write to the current thread's writer, default sys.stdout
